create_Config: create a Config instance to set E-LPIPS metric type, dropout, offset, flip, scale, and color randomization options
call_set_scale_levels: call set_scale_levels on a Config to set the number of scale levels and their inverse-square probabilities
call_validate: call validate on a Config to assert metric type, color mode, and scale probabilities are consistent
call_sample_ensemble: call sample_ensemble with a Config to sample random offset, flip, swap, color, and scale transformation parameters
call_Metric_forward: call forward on a Metric instance to evaluate perceptual distances between image and reference tensors
